tasks.label: FocusFlow: Stop Dev
tasks.command: $ports=5173..5178; $procIds=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Where-Object { $ports -contains $_.LocalPort } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique); if(-not $procIds){ Write-Output 'NO_DEV_PORT_LISTENERS'; exit 0 }; foreach($procId in $procIds){ try { Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('STOPPED_PID=' + $procId) } catch { Write-Output ('FAILED_PID=' + $procId + ' ' + $_.Exception.Message) } }

tasks.label: smoke-test-ai-endpoint-upgrade
tasks.command: $uri='https://focusflow-app-nu.vercel.app/api/ai/generate'; $body=@{kind='quiz'; provider='auto'; sourceText='Photosynthesis uses chlorophyll to convert light energy into chemical energy. The light-dependent reactions produce ATP and NADPH. The Calvin cycle fixes carbon dioxide into glucose.'; questionCount=5} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6; try { $resp=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $uri -Method POST -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body; $json=$resp.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output ('API_STATUS=' + [int]$resp.StatusCode); Write-Output ('PROVIDER=' + $json.providerUsed); Write-Output ('COUNT=' + @($json.data).Count) } catch { $status=$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__; Write-Output ('API_STATUS=' + [int]$status); $reader=New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()); $reader.BaseStream.Position=0; $reader.DiscardBufferedData(); Write-Output ($reader.ReadToEnd()) }
